description: Gallery of diagrams created by an AI assistant with the draw.io MCP server, each from one prompt with Claude Sonnet 5.5, unedited. Images: <image>.svg (light) and <image>-dark.svg (dark) in this folder, editable SVGs with the diagram embedded. Shown on https://www.drawio.com/mcp/ and in the draw.io documentation, which read this file when the site is built.

items.title: Flowchart
items.prompt: Draw an online shop's order process as a diagram: a flowchart with at least two decisions and one retry loop (if the payment fails, retry up to 3 times).

items.title: Flowchart, professional theme
items.prompt: Create a flowchart for an IT incident response process in the professional theme: detect, triage, severity high?, escalate to on-call, investigate, fix, verify, post-mortem.

items.title: Decision tree
items.prompt: Draw a decision tree that helps choose a database for a new project.

items.title: Swimlane process
items.prompt: Draw an employee onboarding process as a diagram: a swimlane process with three lanes (HR, IT, Manager) and at least six steps.

items.title: BPMN process
items.prompt: Draw a BPMN process for a purchase order approval: a start event, submit the request, a manager approval gateway, procurement, rejection, and end events.

items.title: Sequence diagram
items.prompt: Draw the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow as a diagram: a sequence diagram between the user, the browser, the client app, the authorization server and the resource server.

items.title: ZenUML sequence
items.prompt: Draw a ZenUML sequence diagram of a customer ordering food in a delivery app.

items.title: State diagram
items.prompt: Draw a state diagram for the lifecycle of an online order: created, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled and refunded.

items.title: User journey
items.prompt: Draw a user journey for buying a train ticket online, with how satisfied the traveller is at each step.

items.title: Event model
items.prompt: Draw an event model for booking a hotel room: the screens, commands, events and read models.

items.title: Data flow diagram
items.prompt: Draw a data flow diagram for an online store's checkout: the customer, the web app, a payment service, the order database and an email service.

items.title: UML class diagram
items.prompt: Draw a UML class diagram for an online store: Customer, Order, OrderItem, Product and Payment, with their main attributes, a few methods and the relationships between them.

items.title: ER diagram
items.prompt: Draw an ER diagram for a blog: users, posts, comments, tags and a post_tags join table.

items.title: Use case diagram
items.prompt: Draw a use case diagram for an ATM.

items.title: C4 container diagram
items.prompt: Draw a C4 container diagram for an online banking system: the customer, a web app, a mobile app, an API application, a database, the mainframe banking system and an email system.

items.title: Requirement diagram
items.prompt: Draw a requirement diagram for a door access control system: functional and safety requirements, the components that satisfy them and the tests that verify them.

items.title: Packet diagram
items.prompt: Draw the TCP header as a packet diagram.

items.title: Git graph
items.prompt: Draw a git branching diagram: a feature branch for the login page with two commits, a bug fix on main in between, then the merge and a 1.0 release.

items.title: UML component diagram
items.prompt: Draw a UML component diagram of an online shop: web frontend, catalog, cart, order and payment components with their provided and required interfaces, and an external payment provider.

items.title: UML deployment diagram
items.prompt: Draw a UML deployment diagram of a web application: the user's browser, a load balancer, two application servers running the app, a database server with PostgreSQL, and a Redis cache.

items.title: ArchiMate
items.prompt: Draw an ArchiMate view of an insurance claim process: the customer, the business process to submit and handle a claim, the application services and components that support it, and the technology they run on.

items.title: Sitemap
items.prompt: Draw the sitemap of a small company website: home, about us with team and careers, products with three product pages, blog, support with FAQ and contact.

items.title: Three-tier web app
items.prompt: Draw a three-tier web application architecture with a load balancer, two web servers, an application server cluster and a primary database with a read replica.

items.title: Microservices
items.prompt: Draw the system architecture of a food delivery app: mobile apps for customers and couriers, an API gateway, order, restaurant, courier and payment services, a message queue between them, and a database per service.

items.title: Microservices, dark theme
items.prompt: Draw the microservices architecture of a ride-sharing app in the dark theme: rider app, driver app, API gateway, trip, pricing, payment and notification services, and a message queue.

items.title: CI/CD pipeline
items.prompt: Draw our CI/CD pipeline: a push to GitHub triggers build, unit tests and a security scan; then deploy to staging, run integration tests, wait for manual approval and deploy to production, with a rollback if the production smoke tests fail.

items.title: AWS
items.prompt: Draw the AWS architecture of a photo-sharing app as a diagram, using CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB and Cognito.

items.title: Azure
items.prompt: Draw an Azure architecture for a web app: Front Door, App Service, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Blob Storage and Entra ID, using Azure icons.

items.title: Google Cloud
items.prompt: Draw a Google Cloud data pipeline: Pub/Sub, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage and Looker, using Google Cloud icons.

items.title: SAP integration
items.prompt: Draw an SAP integration architecture: in an SAP BTP subaccount, SAP Integration Suite connects a partner's system to SAP S/4HANA on premise through the SAP Cloud Connector, and stores data in SAP HANA Cloud. Use SAP icons.

items.title: Kubernetes
items.prompt: Draw the Kubernetes deployment of a web shop: an ingress, frontend and API deployments with services, a Redis cache and a PostgreSQL stateful set, using Kubernetes icons.

items.title: Office network
items.prompt: Draw the network diagram of a small office: internet connection, firewall, router, two switches, six workstations, a network printer, a file server and a Wi-Fi access point with laptops.

items.title: Block diagram
items.prompt: Draw a block diagram of a home Wi-Fi router: power supply, processor, memory, Wi-Fi radios, Ethernet switch and antennas.

items.title: AWS, two availability zones
items.prompt: Draw a highly available AWS deployment across two availability zones: Route 53, an application load balancer, a VPC with public and private subnets in each zone, EC2 instances in an auto scaling group, and an RDS primary database with a standby replica. Use AWS icons.

items.title: Server rack
items.prompt: Draw a 42U server rack: a patch panel and two network switches at the top, a firewall, four 1U servers, a 2U storage array and a UPS at the bottom.

items.title: Mind map
items.prompt: Make a mind map for planning a family vacation.

items.title: Timeline
items.prompt: Show the history of the internet as a timeline.

items.title: Gantt chart
items.prompt: Create a Gantt chart for a 3-month website redesign project.

items.title: Kanban board
items.prompt: Show our sprint as a kanban board. To do: release notes, new screenshots. In progress: login bug, API docs. Done: 1.2.0 release, Docker image.

items.title: Org chart
items.prompt: Draw the org chart of a 15-person startup: the CEO; a CTO with two engineering managers who each lead three engineers; a CFO with an accountant; and a COO with a head of sales and a support lead. Use names and job titles.

items.title: Fishbone diagram
items.prompt: Draw a fishbone diagram of the causes of late deliveries: people, process, equipment, materials, environment and management.

items.title: Wardley map
items.prompt: Draw a Wardley map for an online tea shop: customer, website, payment, inventory, fulfilment, cloud hosting and power.

items.title: Tree view
items.prompt: Show the folder structure of a typical React project as a tree view.

items.title: Wireframe
items.prompt: Draw a wireframe of a mobile app login screen: logo, email and password fields, a sign-in button, a forgot-password link and social login buttons.

items.title: Dashboard wireframe
items.prompt: Draw a wireframe of a sales dashboard web page: a sidebar menu, a header with search and the user menu, four KPI cards, a line chart, a bar chart and a table of recent orders.

items.title: Floor plan
items.prompt: Draw a floor plan of a two-bedroom apartment: a living room with an open kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a hallway with the entrance. Show the walls, doors, windows and the main furniture.

items.title: Seating plan
items.prompt: Draw the seating plan for a wedding reception: eight round tables for eight guests, the head table, a dance floor, the bar, the DJ and the entrance.

items.title: Electrical circuit
items.prompt: Draw the circuit diagram of a 5 V power supply: a 230 V transformer, a bridge rectifier, a smoothing capacitor, a 7805 voltage regulator, an output capacitor and an LED with its resistor as a power indicator.

items.title: Logic circuit
items.prompt: Draw a full adder as a logic circuit: inputs A, B and Carry-in, two XOR gates, two AND gates and an OR gate, and the outputs Sum and Carry-out.

items.title: P&ID
items.prompt: Draw a P&ID for a simple heating process: a feed tank, a pump, a control valve, a heat exchanger heated by steam and a product tank, with a flow transmitter, a temperature transmitter and a temperature controller.

items.title: Fault tree
items.prompt: Draw a fault tree for a car that won't start: dead battery, starter failure, no fuel and ignition fault, with their causes and the AND and OR gates.

items.title: SWOT analysis
items.prompt: Make a SWOT analysis for a small neighbourhood coffee shop.

items.title: Business model canvas
items.prompt: Fill in a business model canvas for a meal-kit delivery startup.

items.title: Product roadmap
items.prompt: Draw a product roadmap for 2027 by quarter, with three lanes: mobile app, web app and platform, and two or three items per lane.

items.title: Sales funnel
items.prompt: Draw a sales funnel: 10,000 website visitors, 2,500 leads, 800 qualified leads, 300 proposals and 120 customers, with the conversion rate between the stages.

items.title: Infographic
items.prompt: Make an infographic of the five steps to launch a product: research, design, build, test and launch, each with an icon and a one-line description.

items.title: Pyramid
items.prompt: Draw Maslow's hierarchy of needs as a pyramid.

items.title: Concept map
items.prompt: Draw a concept map of photosynthesis.

items.title: Water cycle
items.prompt: Draw the water cycle as a diagram for a school class: evaporation, condensation, precipitation and collection, with the sun, clouds, mountains, a lake and the sea.

items.title: Family tree
items.prompt: Draw a family tree of three generations: grandparents on both sides, their children with their partners, and four grandchildren. Use first names and birth years.

items.title: Pie chart
items.prompt: Make a pie chart of our website traffic sources: search 46%, direct 27%, social 15%, referral 12%.

items.title: XY chart
items.prompt: Plot our monthly active users for the first half of 2026 as a bar chart with a trend line: January 12k, February 14k, March 17k, April 21k, May 24k, June 29k.

items.title: Quadrant chart
items.prompt: Put these features on an effort/impact quadrant chart: dark mode, single sign-on, PDF export, onboarding tour, audit log.

items.title: Radar chart
items.prompt: Compare three laptops on a radar chart: performance, battery life, display, weight, price and build quality.

items.title: Sankey diagram
items.prompt: Show the energy flows of a home as a Sankey diagram: power from the grid and from solar panels going to heating, hot water, appliances, lighting and charging the electric car.

items.title: Treemap
items.prompt: Show our cloud spend by service as a treemap: compute 45%, storage 20%, databases 15%, networking 10%, analytics 7%, other 3%.

items.title: Venn diagram
items.prompt: Draw a Venn diagram of the skills of a data scientist: statistics, programming and domain knowledge.
